science: In over 24 clinical studies, KSM-66 has been shown to reduce cortisol levels by up to 27% (m1042439118599157, 33d, proven)
new_information: it's not just about getting older. it's likely a result of cortisol spikes during premenopause and menopause (m1042439118599157, 33d)
when you're under chronic stress, and especially during menopause, you're under chronic hormonal stress (m1008234278313637, 96d)

transfer: Yes as structure (the 'explainer clip that explained everything' greenscreen and the 'it's not just age' reframe). AVIA must not imply it treats menopause or replaces hormones; say 'supports healthy cortisol during the hormonal shifts of perimenopause'.

name: One habit you never forget (coffee beats gummies and pill stacks)
sentence: I kept forgetting my ashwagandha gummies, but I never forget my coffee.
from_belief: To get the benefits I need to add another supplement and remember to take it.
to_belief: I already have one non-negotiable habit; put the ingredients in it. 'I didn't need a new habit. I needed a better version of the one I already had.'
science: two cups give me half my daily recommended dose of ashwagandha (m1056815973341152, 47d, proven)
300 milligrams of KSM-66 Ashwagandha (m1613586016845993)
new_information: Gummies taste like candy because they're made like candy ... the serving size suggestions become guidelines (m1649758889987275, 3d, scaling)
demo: Creator holds the gummy jar next to the coffee bag; Target shelf shots.
saturation: owned by this brand in the sample (it names Goli gummies directly in m1649758889987275)
transfer: Partly. AVIA is itself a capsule, so the anti-pill argument cuts against it. The usable structure is the 'one morning step instead of a cabinet' consolidation: seven ingredients in one capsule replaces separate ashwagandha, magnesium, L-theanine bottles. Do not attack gummies by brand name.

name: Calm energy: caffeine without the spike and crash
sentence: So you get the energy without the spike.
from_belief: Coffee jitters and the 3pm crash are the price of being functional.
to_belief: KSM-66 plus L-theanine smooth the caffeine so you get 'that perfect medium energy'; 'It's still real coffee, 100% Arabica, full caffeine, I didn't have to give anything up.'
science: l-theanine helps promote a calmer more balanced caffeine experience (m1122346970213788, 9d, scaling)
new_information: the l theanine neutralizes the caffeine jitters while the ashwagandha actively regulates the stress (m2270009490403791, 18d, barely shown)

saturation: shared with every functional coffee (mushroom coffee, Ryze, MUD/WTR) and with caffeine-free calm brands
transfer: Yes. AVIA contains L-theanine and is taken in the morning, so 'keep your coffee, lose the 3pm crash' is a truthful structure framed as support ('L-theanine is studied for calm focus'). Not a claim that AVIA changes caffeine.

name: It's not fat, it's fluid (cortisol water retention / puffy face)
sentence: It's not fat, it's fluid. ... When your cortisol is constantly spiked, your body holds onto water.
from_belief: My puffy face and undefined jaw are fat.
to_belief: High cortisol makes the body hold water, which is the puffiness; 'If your chin looks like this ... you are not fat. You just have high cortisol.'
new_information: More cortisol means more fat storage, more water retention, more testosterone suppression. (m27007485192251138, 57d, proven)
when stress stays high for too long, cortisol can stay elevated, and that can affect digestion and how your body holds onto water (m1401081351654475, 29d)
demo: Before/after face and stomach shots; pointing at chin and 'pooch'.
saturation: shared (cortisol face is a category trope)
transfer: Structure yes (the 'not X, it's Y' visual callout on the face and belly). Keep outcome language soft ('feel less puffy'); before/after of a face is medium-to-high risk.

sentence: When your body stays in stress mode even when you're not
